test_title: SSC MTS (2022) Official Paper (Held On: 20 Jun, 2023 Shift 1)
subject: general
question:
Select the word segment that substitutes (replaces) the bracketed word segment correctly and completes the sentence meaningfully. Select the option ‘no correction required’ if the sentence is correct as given.

She (had a reputation) brilliance.
solution:
The correct answer is option no.(3) i.e.** 'has a reputation for'.** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The given phrase** 'had a reputation'** will be replaced by **'has a reputation for'.**
 
• The phrase **'had a reputation'** is not appropriate for the given sentence.
 
• The word **'reputation' **always follows preposition** 'for', **so 'reputation for' will be correct.
 
• The correct phrase will be** 'had a reputation for' **or** 'has a reputation for'** will be the correct phrase.
 
• The complete sentence will be:*** She has a reputation for __brilliance.***

Therefore,the correct answer is option no.(3) [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

 
• Option 2: **'have a reputation for'** is not grammatically correct; she is a singular subject so,**she has** is the correct agreement.
 
• Option 4: ** 'has a reputation of' **is not grammatically correct; reputation follows for not of so,**reputation for** is the correct formation.
